verdict.rationale: Composio publishes an OpenAPI spec (probe-2) and extensive docs with code snippets (docs-1, docs-23), which could back an interactive reference, but there is no direct evidence of a Swagger/Redoc-style 'try it now' playground or explicitly runnable examples in the docs. missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive 'try it' console, evidence of live/executable code snippets in the docs UI, independent user reports of using the interactive reference.
